items.actClause: AN ACT to establish the toll advisory task force, and providing for the powers and duties thereof
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5092

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to establish the toll advisory task force,
and providing for the powers and duties thereof

 PURPOSE :

Establishes the toll advisory task force to study and report upon the
current road and bridge toll rates, commuter discounts, resident
discounts, and funding for the New NY bridge.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :

§ 1. Creates the Toll Advisory Task Force requiring the commissioner
of transportation and the chairperson of the thruway authority to
convene a toll advisory task force to review toll rates, commuter
discount options, resident discount programs, and commercial vehicle
rates in order to ensure affordable travel on New York roads and
bridges.

The task force shall be made up of nine members and shall hold monthly
public hearings. The task force shall be required to make a report on
their findings by September 1, 2018.

§ 2 Effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :

Currently, a toll freeze is in place until 2020. In connection with
that freeze, the Thruway Authority committed to convene a toll
advisory task force by the end of 2016 and hold hearings on the topic
of a resident toll discount as well as other cost-saving measures for
toll-payers on the New NY Bridge and the Thruway as a whole. However,
this task force never convened nor did it ever hold any public
hearings. This is concerning because the freeze that is in place is
costing the state over a billion dollars and once lifted, it will have
to be compensated for in some way, likely through increased tolls or
taxpayer dollars.

The Toll Advisory Task Force will therefore be tasked in reviewing
toll rates, potential commuter discount options, a resident discount
program, commercial vehicle rates, and ways to properly secure funding
for the New NY Bridge. Through this task force, thruway users and
taxpayers concerns about how the Thruway and New NY Bridge should be
addressed.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New Legislation.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

To be determined.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
